# 1 Enoch Chapter 46 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Ge'ez MS | **Section:** Book of Parables

---

**46:1** And there I saw one who had a Head of Days, and his head was white like wool, and with him was another being whose countenance had the appearance of a man, and his face was full of grace, like one of the holy angels.

**46:2** And I asked the angel who went with me and showed me all the hidden things about that Son of Man — who he was, and where he came from, and why he went with the Head of Days.

**46:3** And he answered me and said: "This is the Son of Man who possesses righteousness, with whom righteousness dwells, and who reveals all the treasures of what is hidden, because the Lord of Spirits has chosen him, and his portion before the Lord of Spirits has surpassed all things in uprightness forever."

**46:4** "And this Son of Man whom you have seen shall raise up the kings and the mighty from their seats and the strong from their thrones, and shall loosen the reins of the strong and break the teeth of the sinners."

**46:5** "And he shall put down the kings from their thrones and kingdoms, because they do not exalt and praise him, nor acknowledge with thanks from whom the kingdom was given to them."

**46:6** "And he shall put down the faces of the strong, and shame shall fill them; darkness shall be their dwelling and worms shall be their bed, and they shall have no hope of rising from their beds, because they do not exalt the name of the Lord of Spirits."

**46:7** "These are they who pass judgment on the stars of heaven, who raise their hands against the Most High, who tread upon the earth and dwell on it. All their deeds manifest unrighteousness; their power rests upon their riches, and their faith is in the gods which they have made with their own hands, while they deny the name of the Lord of Spirits."

**46:8** "And they persecute the houses of his congregation and the faithful who cling to the name of the Lord of Spirits."

---

*SOPHIA notes: CRITICAL CHAPTER. All three agents agree on "Son of Man" as the title for the figure beside the Head of Days. Key decisions: "Head of Days" (all three) preserved as the title. V. 3: "possesses righteousness, with whom righteousness dwells" — LOGOS formulation adopted. "Break the teeth of the sinners" (v. 4) — retained as striking image. "Cling to" (PNEUMA, v. 8) adopted over "hang upon" (EMET) and "cling to" (LOGOS) — all equivalent; LOGOS confirmed. See disagreement log.*
